text: Integration tests use WebApplicationFactory<Program> with a Testcontainers SQL Server: `dotnet test tests/HarborPay.IntegrationTests`. Docker has to be running; the first run pulls a ~1.5GB image.
EF Core migrations: `dotnet ef migrations add <Name> -p src/HarborPay.Infrastructure -s src/HarborPay.Api`. Without -s you get 'Unable to create an object of type AppDbContext'.

Money is decimal(19,4) everywhere. Every new decimal property needs HasPrecision(19, 4) in its IEntityTypeConfiguration, otherwise SQL Server uses the default precision and values get rounded; EF only warns once at startup.

Commands and queries go through MediatR. Validation is the ValidationBehavior pipeline with FluentValidation, validators are picked up by assembly scanning, so don't call them by hand inside handlers.

POST /payments requires an Idempotency-Key header. Keys are kept 24h in IdempotencyRecords; same key with a different body returns 422 on purpose (not 409), same key + same body replays the stored response.
Local secrets go in `dotnet user-secrets` on the Api project, e.g. `dotnet user-secrets set Psp:ApiKey psp_test_FAKE_0000`. Never put the PSP key in appsettings.Development.json.

API hanging at startup locally is almost always the SQL container not being ready yet; the startup health check waits up to 30s. `docker logs harborpay-sql` shows 'SQL Server is now ready for client connections' once it's up.
The N+1 on GET /merchants/{id}/payouts was fixed with AsSplitQuery(). Read endpoints should use AsNoTracking(); change tracking cost ~30% on big lists.

Merchant-scoped endpoints need [Authorize(Policy = "MerchantMember")] (or .RequireAuthorization("MerchantMember") on minimal API groups). The policy compares the merchant_id claim with the {merchantId} route value; plain [Authorize] only checks the JWT is valid.
CI runs `dotnet format --verify-no-changes`. Run `dotnet format` locally before pushing. Nullable is enabled and warnings are errors in src/.
Conventional Commits, squash merge, one approval from payments-core and green CI.
Migrations never run on app startup. The release pipeline applies `dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent` as its own step before the App Service slot swap.

Merchant webhooks go through the outbox: OutboxMessages rows dispatched by OutboxWorker every 5s. It claims rows with WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST) so several instances don't send the same message; any new query on that table must keep those hints.

Settlement cutoff is 17:00 Europe/Amsterdam. Use the IANA id "Europe/Amsterdam" with TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById; the Windows id 'W. Europe Standard Time' throws in the Linux containers if ICU isn't in the image (InvariantGlobalization must stay false).
Unit tests are xUnit + NSubstitute + FluentAssertions. `dotnet test --filter Category!=Integration` skips the container-backed ones.
The OpenAPI doc is generated at build into openapi/harborpay.json (Swashbuckle CLI). Commit it; the SDK team diffs it on every release.
Logs go to Seq locally (http://localhost:5341). Every request has X-Correlation-Id; filter Seq with CorrelationId = '<id>' to see one request end to end.

PspClient is a typed HttpClient with Polly: 3 retries with jitter on 5xx/timeouts, circuit breaker after 5 failures. Refunds are deliberately excluded from automatic retries (a timed-out refund may have gone through); they go to the RefundStatusPoller instead.
/payments is rate limited with the built-in ASP.NET Core RateLimiter: fixed window, 100 requests/min, partitioned by X-Api-Key, so callers without a key share one bucket.
The reconciliation CSV export is a Hangfire recurring job at 02:00 UTC. Dashboard at /hangfire, admin role only.

The SQL Server collation is case-insensitive (SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS), so unique indexes like merchant reference are case-insensitive. SQLite in-memory tests won't catch that; it's why integration tests use the real SQL container.

Naya endpoint banana ho toh: Request/Response records Api/Contracts mein, Command + Handler + Validator Application project mein, aur route Minimal API group mein (Endpoints/PaymentsEndpoints.cs jaisa). Naye controllers mat banao.
global.json pins the .NET 8 SDK (8.0.4xx) with rollForward disabled. 'A compatible .NET SDK was not found' means install that feature band.
No card numbers in our DB, only PSP tokens. Logs go through SensitiveDataDestructuringPolicy which masks Iban, Email and Phone properties; add any new PII property name there.
Build only what changed: `dbt build --select state:modified+ --defer --state prod-artifacts/`. Fetch the prod manifest first with `make fetch-manifest`.
Local Airflow is the Astro CLI: `astro dev start`, UI at localhost:8080 (admin/admin). After changing requirements.txt run `astro dev restart`.

Snowflake uppercases unquoted identifiers. A dbt alias like `as "orderId"` creates a quoted mixed-case column and every downstream reference to ORDERID fails. Use lowercase snake_case aliases; quoting is off in dbt_project.yml.

Incremental models merge on unique_key and filter is_incremental() on _loaded_at with a 3-day lookback for late-arriving events. Full refresh of fct_events takes ~2h on XL, ask in the channel before running one.

DAG files are parsed every 30s. No Snowflake queries or Variable.get() at the top level of a DAG file, it slows the scheduler and hammers the metadata DB; use templated {{ var.value.x }} inside operators.
Tasks stuck in queued locally usually means the scheduler container was OOM-killed. Check `astro dev logs -s` and give Docker at least 6GB.
`dbt source freshness` runs hourly. The stripe source warns at 6h and errors at 24h; Fivetran syncs stripe every 6h, so a warning after a slightly late sync is expected and clears itself.
SQL style is enforced by sqlfluff (dbt templater): leading commas, lowercase keywords. `sqlfluff fix models/marts/` before a PR; CI lints changed files only.
Layers: staging (stg_, one per source table, renames and casts only, no joins) -> intermediate (int_) -> marts (fct_ / dim_). Joins start at int_.

Airflow connects to Snowflake with key-pair auth: base64 private key in the snowflake_default connection extra. Password auth for service users was turned off by security in August, so svc_ users can't log in with a password at all.
Warehouses: TRANSFORM_WH (M) for dbt, LOADER_WH for loads, auto_suspend 60s. Queries showing up on COMPUTE_WH mean someone's dev target points at the wrong warehouse.
Merging to main runs `astro deploy` for DAGs and publishes the dbt docs site. Prod dbt runs are Cosmos task groups inside the DAGs, not dbt Cloud.
tests/dags/test_dag_integrity.py imports every DAG and checks for import errors, cycles and missing owners; `pytest tests/dags -q` takes ~20s.
Backfills: set max_active_runs=1 on the DAG before `airflow dags backfill -s <start> -e <end> <dag_id>`, otherwise the runs merge into the same incremental table concurrently and deadlock.
raw.app_users email and phone are masked by a Snowflake masking policy for every role except PII_READER. dbt runs as TRANSFORMER and sees hashes, so cross-source joins on email must use email_sha256.
dbt 1.8 with dbt-snowflake 1.8, pinned in requirements-dbt.txt. Run `dbt deps` after pulling; packages.yml has dbt_utils and dbt_expectations.

'Object does not exist or not authorized' in a dev run usually means --defer resolved a ref to prod while the parent only exists in your DBT_<USER> schema, or the other way round. Build the parent in dev first or drop --defer.
Census syncs dim_accounts_crm to the CRM. Renaming or dropping a column there doesn't fail anything: Census just stops updating that field. Update the Census field mapping in the same change.
One branch per ticket (DATA-1234-short-desc). The PR template asks for downstream lineage: paste `dbt ls --select <model>+ --output name`.
Airflow failure callbacks #data-alerts mein aate hain. Us din ka on-call 'ack' emoji lagata hai, jis alert pe ack hai use dobara investigate mat karo.
fct_events is clustered by (event_date, event_type). Always filter on event_date or the query scans ~4TB; SYSTEM$CLUSTERING_INFORMATION shows clustering depth.
All timestamps land as TIMESTAMP_NTZ in UTC. Convert with convert_timezone('UTC', 'Asia/Kolkata', ts) only in marts built for the India ops team.
profiles.yml repo mein nahi hai. ~/.dbt/profiles.yml mein apna dev target banao, template docs/profiles.example.yml mein hai: schema DBT_<tumhara naam>, warehouse TRANSFORM_WH.
Custom generic tests go in tests/generic/ (e.g. test_not_negative), singular data tests in tests/singular/. Distribution checks use dbt_expectations.
CLI tests: `xcodebuild test -scheme PocketFit -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'`. Use the shared PocketFit scheme; personal schemes don't include the UI test target.

Changing a SwiftData @Model property type needs a new VersionedSchema and a stage in the SchemaMigrationPlan (Persistence/Schemas/). Without it the app crashes at launch with 'Cannot use staged migration with an unknown model version'.
All HealthKit access goes through the HealthStore actor (Services/HealthStore.swift); don't create HKHealthStore anywhere else. Authorization is requested only during onboarding.
HealthKit never reports that read access was denied, queries just come back empty. Don't treat empty results as an error; show the 'check permissions in the Health app' hint.
Snapshot tests (swift-snapshot-testing) are recorded on iPhone 16 / iOS 18.1 only. Other simulators or runtimes give pixel diffs everywhere; CI uses the same runtime.
`bundle exec fastlane beta` builds and uploads to TestFlight; `fastlane release` submits for review. match needs MATCH_PASSWORD (in the team password manager).

BGAppRefreshTask never fires on its own in the simulator. Pause in the debugger and run `e -l objc -- (void)[[BGTaskScheduler sharedScheduler] _simulateLaunchForTaskWithIdentifier:@"com.pocketfit.refresh"]`, then continue.
SwiftLint runs as a build tool plugin; `swiftlint --fix` autocorrects. Line length 140, force unwraps are errors outside test targets.
View models are @Observable (Observation framework) and injected with .environment(). No Combine in new code; WorkoutTimer still uses Combine, leave it alone.
The workout history list stuttered past ~2k workouts because @Query was sorting in memory. Fixed with #Index on Workout.startDate plus fetchLimit paging in HistoryViewModel.

Live Activity updates from the app are throttled once it's backgrounded. Use Text(timerInterval:) in the widget so the system renders the countdown, and send state changes via APNs with the liveactivity push type.
SPM only, no CocoaPods. If packages won't resolve: File > Packages > Reset Package Caches, or delete ~/Library/Caches/org.swift.swiftpm and DerivedData.
Pro status comes from StoreKit 2 Transaction.currentEntitlements at launch (it's local and fast). Don't treat a cached isPro in UserDefaults as the source of truth, it's trivially editable.
StoreKit testing: Products.storekit is attached to the scheme; unit tests use SKTestSession to simulate purchases, renewals and refunds. Sandbox accounts are only needed for TestFlight builds.
Commit subjects start with the ticket id (PF-123: ...). For project.pbxproj conflicts don't hand-merge; take main's version and re-add your files in Xcode.

Store everything metric in SwiftData (kg, metres, seconds) and convert only for display with Measurement + MeasurementFormatter. Weights were once double-converted for imperial users because a view converted an already-converted value.
The main ModelContext autosaves, background @ModelActor contexts don't. Call try modelContext.save() at the end of an import or the changes are lost on relaunch.

Naya screen banana ho toh Features/<Name>/ mein View, ViewModel aur preview fixtures rakho. Previews ke liye PreviewContainer.shared use karo, warna SwiftData container ke bina preview crash hota hai.
Xcode 16.1+ is required: the project uses Swift 6 language mode with strict concurrency. Older Xcode fails with "unknown option '-swift-version 6'".

Under Swift 6 strict concurrency, HealthKit completion handlers arrive on a background queue. Make the closure @Sendable and hop with await MainActor.run; don't paper over it with @preconcurrency import HealthKit.
App Store screenshots come from `bundle exec fastlane snapshot` driving PocketFitUITests/ScreenshotTests.swift; 6.9" and 6.5" sizes are required.

iCloud sync is SwiftData + CloudKit (container iCloud.com.pocketfit.app). CloudKit requires every property to be optional or defaulted and doesn't support unique constraints, so @Attribute(.unique) silently breaks sync.
Watch app ka data phone pe nahi aa raha toh pehle WCSession activation state check karo. Simulator pe dono apps paired simulators pe install honi chahiye, warna isReachable hamesha false rehta hai.
Keep launch light: HealthKit queries start in .task on the dashboard, not in App.init. Launch budget is 400ms, measured with the Instruments App Launch template.
